packageRules.description: glacier is ours and its own CI gates every release, so its bumps land without waiting to be merged by hand. Grouped because the chart dependency and the container image are one release: a PR that moves only one of them leaves the cluster running a chart and an image that disagree, which is exactly what happened between v0.1.1 and v0.2.0.

The blog image is ours and every push to blog/ publishes a higher patch, so its bumps land without waiting to be merged by hand. The chart tag is the only thing that decides what the cluster serves: without this rule a published post sits in the registry until someone notices the renovate PR.
Keep the Beszel hub and agent on the same release and let Renovate apply patch/minor updates automatically.
